subject: Re: Great House Farm / suspected historic fraud
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Victim Liaison Cymru,

Thank you for your email of 8 October 2026 acknowledging receipt of my 30 September correspondence and confirming it has been passed to a CPS manager.

I note the apology for the delay in acknowledgement. Please keep me informed of any further progress or if additional information is required.

Yours faithfully,
Requester
